meta.name: Layer keyframes
meta.description: Keyframe tracks on HTML layers: a card pop-in with overshoot, squash and stretch, a card flip, a needle swinging past its target and a three-depth parallax.
meta.creativeDirection: Audience: motion designers checking what layer keyframes can do. Direction: one move per beat on a dark ink ground, lavender and rose shapes, a small uppercase label naming the move. Every move is a keyframe track on the layer itself: scale on a spring for the pop-in, opposing scaleX/scaleY about the bottom edge for the squash, scaleX to zero and back across two faces for the flip, rotate about the base with a loose spring for the needle, x tracks at three speeds for the parallax. Review: centres stay put while cards scale, the ball lands on the floor line, the flip never shows both faces, the needle pivots on the hub.

sections.name: pop_in
sections.purpose: A card pops in on a spring: scale 0 to an overshoot and back to 1, about its centre.
